description: This source file contains a test suite for parsing talk configuration in an iOS application. It includes multiple test cases validating the handling of various configuration scenarios such as provider payload validation and silence timeout defaults.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that includes multiple test cases to validate talk configuration parsing logic.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests that the parser rejects a provider payload that lacks a resolved configuration.

methods.name: doesNotRejectLegacyTalkFieldWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Ensures that legacy fields are ignored when the normalized payload is missing relevant data.

methods.name: readsConfiguredSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Validates that the silence timeout value is correctly read from the configuration.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Checks that a default silence timeout is used when none is specified.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Validates fallback to default timeout when an invalid timeout value is provided.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenBool
methods.description: Tests fallback to default silence timeout when a boolean is provided instead of a number.
